newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS-factors to watch - Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS-factors to watch - Sept 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Friday morning.
** Indian federal police filed criminal charges on Thursday against former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao, adding to the political leader's mounting legal troubles
Earlier a judge rejected Rao's request for anticipatory
bail against possible arrest in another criminal conspiracy case
** Big world gold producers on Thursday said the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) plan to sell gold reserves was helping depress the price of gold bullion
** London gold prices slumped on Thursday afternoon after news the IMF had the necessary majority to sell five million ounces of gold from its reserves
** U.S. firm Medtronic Inc is developing a low-cost pacemaker exclusively for sale in China, India and other developing Asian nations
** The spot dollar/rupee INR= opened down at 35.72/74 per dollar against 35.69/70 previous close, month-end demand for dollars seen, dealers say
** On Thursday, Indian share prices fell broadly in jittery trade triggered by fresh worries of political uncertainty, brokers said
** The 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) index .BSESN closed 36.87 points, or 1.10 percent, lower at 3,307.05
** The 100-share National index .NATEX fell 15.37 points, or 1.03 percent, at 1,477.60
** The 50-stock National Stock Exchange index .NSEI dropped 11.98 points, or 1.23 percent, to 959.31
** The 500-share CRISIL index was off 7.41 points, or 1.14 percent, at 642.23
** The Delhi share index dropped 9.39 points to 727.92
** The Calcutta index .CALSN shed 2.32 points to 423.81
** The Madras index .MDSI fell 12.35 points to 3,408.97
** The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR Index JCEAI slipped 0.97 points, or 1.43 percent, to 67.02 with the premium over the local market at 12.15 percent
